name: Jev role screen: nine synthetic boundary cases

cases.label_reason: US residency is required, excludes Serbia, and relocation is not offered.

role.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
role.remote_or_relocation: Fully remote. Applicants must reside in the United States. No relocation support.
role.description: SQL, dbt, and data modelling. Senior role. Fully remote, but applicants must reside in the United States. No relocation support.

cases.label_reason: Missing country eligibility is uncertainty, not evidence for a confident rejection.

role.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
role.remote_or_relocation: Fully remote. Eligible countries and residency restrictions are not stated.
role.description: SQL, dbt, and data modelling. Senior role. Fully remote. No eligible countries or residency restrictions are mentioned.

cases.label_reason: Relocation support keeps an otherwise relevant overseas hybrid role in consideration.

role.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
role.remote_or_relocation: Hybrid, three days on-site weekly. Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance offered.
role.description: SQL, dbt, and data modelling. Senior role. Berlin office, three days on-site weekly. Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance offered.

cases.label_reason: An explicitly entry-level role fails the senior-or-above requirement.

role.title: Junior Data Analyst
role.description: Entry-level role, 0-1 years of experience, supervised spreadsheet reporting. Fully remote worldwide.

cases.label_reason: Senior analytics-engineering duties count despite the BI Developer title.

role.title: Senior BI Developer
role.description: Owns dbt transformations, warehouse data models, ELT pipelines, testing, and documentation. SQL and five years of relevant experience required. Fully remote worldwide.

cases.label_reason: Overseas mandatory office attendance without relocation support fails the location rule.

role.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
role.remote_or_relocation: Hybrid, three days in the Berlin office weekly. No sponsorship or relocation support.
role.description: Strong SQL and dbt match. Senior role. Must work in the Berlin office three days weekly. Applicants must already have German work authorization; no sponsorship or relocation support.

cases.label_reason: A US time-zone preference is not a residency restriction; worldwide applicants are explicitly welcome.

role.title: Senior Growth Engineer
role.remote_or_relocation: Fully remote worldwide. US time-zone overlap preferred; applicants outside the US are welcome.
role.description: Owns experimentation, product analytics, and growth data pipelines. Senior role. Fully remote worldwide. US time-zone overlap preferred; applicants outside the US are welcome.

cases.label_reason: Administrative office-management duties do not overlap the target engineering roles.

role.title: Senior Office Manager
role.description: Manages office suppliers, travel bookings, facilities, and administrative budgets. No engineering, analytics, or data-pipeline duties. Fully remote worldwide.

cases.label_reason: An explicitly mid-level role fails the senior-or-above requirement despite relevant tools.

role.title: Analytics Engineer, Mid-Level
role.description: SQL and dbt, 2-4 years of experience. This is a mid-level position, not a senior role. Fully remote worldwide.
